headline: A Korean newspaper reports that a study links young people's depression in AI-heavy industries to the time since ChatGPT launched.
score_reason: Headline only: study, authors and method unknown, so score lowered by 1.
importance_line: Young workers in finance and tech may be affected, but the study's size, method and whether AI is the cause have not been reported.
summary: Chosun Ilbo's English edition reports on a study that links exposure to generative AI with rising depression among young people in AI-heavy industries since ChatGPT arrived, along with job-loss fears in finance and tech.
